integrity: The local quotient types are proved from explicit orbifold charts and equivariant uniformizations. The bundled finite verifier checks arithmetic and group-weight reductions only and is not used to infer analytic classification from finite experimentation.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies the analytic singularities and minimal-resolution graph of the distinguished surface only; it does not compute Q-Gorenstein deformation spaces, global Picard data, or a full boundary-resolution incidence diagram.
